# Asset licences

Every file under `assets/` has a row here. The rows between the sync markers are written by
`tools/sync_from_threejs.py` (copies from `chennai-open-world/`, decision G-3); add rows for new
assets (for example the new cast in `assets/people/`) outside the markers.

<!-- sync_from_threejs:begin (generated by tools/sync_from_threejs.py; edit the script, not these rows) -->
| Files | What | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assets/world/index.json`, `assets/world/roads.bin`, `assets/world/rail.json`, `assets/world/c/*.bin` | The streamed city: `index.json` (bounds, chunk table, places, landmarks, districts, bus stops, signals, sea), `roads.bin` (road centre lines), `c/<col>_<row>.bin` (buildings, trees, areas per 250 m chunk), `rail.json` (railway tracks and stations). Formats: `chennai-open-world/packages/game-world/src/codec.ts`, read by `src/game_world/` | Built from OpenStreetMap by `chennai-open-world/scripts/build-world.ts` (`npm run build:world`); OSM data timestamp in `index.json` (`dataDate`). Heights, colours, widths and generated trees are estimated, not real | **ODbL 1.0**, © OpenStreetMap contributors (attribution must be shown in the game) |
| `assets/people/legacy/*.glb`, `assets/people/legacy/people.json` | The Three.js game's cast: 37 pedestrians, `<id>.glb` (at most 10k triangles, 512 px) and `<id>_lod1.glb` (at most 3.5k), one 52-bone MPFB `mixamo` skeleton; `people.json` (sex, age, roles, height, triangle counts; its `file` paths are relative to the old `assets/models/`, so `people/x.glb` is `legacy/x.glb` here) | Original, made by `chennai-open-world/tools/blender/characters.py` with MPFB 2.0.18 from MakeHuman assets (see `chennai-open-world/docs/characters.md`) | MakeHuman assets **CC0** except one **CC-BY** garment: `elvs_male_athletic_tank1` (banian vest) by Elvaerwyn, MakeHuman community asset repository (pack shirts03). Garments modelled in code, patterns, skin tones and facial hair are original |
| `assets/people/legacy/player.glb` | The Three.js game's player: a Chennai man of about 32, 29k triangles, 1024 px atlas, same 52-bone skeleton | Original, made by `chennai-open-world/tools/blender/characters.py` with MPFB from MakeHuman assets | CC0 MakeHuman assets; garment recolouring, painted moustache and sandals are original work |
| `assets/animations/locomotion.glb` | Idle, walk and run clips (Mixamo rig, T-pose) | Extracted from the three.js example `Xbot.glb` (Mixamo animations) with `chennai-open-world/scripts/extract-animations.py` | Mixamo animations may be used in games royalty-free under Adobe's terms; check them before a commercial release |
| `assets/vehicles/*.glb` | Auto-rickshaw, hatchback, motorbike, ambulance, bus, each with `_lod1`; wheels and doors as separate nodes (`chennai-open-world/docs/vehicles.md`) | Original, made by `chennai-open-world/tools/blender/vehicles.py` and `auto_rickshaw.py` in Blender 5.2 LTS | Original work for the project: no maker's badges, logos, grilles or liveries; number plates are not real registrations |
| `assets/props/*.glb` | Street props: barrel, crates, clay pots, AC unit, dish antenna, awning, rolling shutter (`ShutterOpen` clip), vegetable handcart (`Roll` clip) | Original, made by `chennai-open-world/tools/blender/street_props.py` in Blender 5.2 LTS | Original work for the project |
| `assets/fonts/*.woff2`, `assets/fonts/OFL.txt` | Noto Sans Tamil Bold cut to the shop-sign glyphs (`noto-sans-tamil-signs`), Noto Sans Tamil and Devanagari cut to the station names; `OFL.txt` is the licence text | Noto fonts (via `@fontsource`), subset with `pyftsubset` (`chennai-open-world/assets/README.md`) | SIL Open Font Licence 1.1, © The Noto Project Authors (`fonts/OFL.txt`) |

## Sound (decision G-82)
Every sound file also has a row in `assets/audio/manifest.json` (source URL, author, licence,
original file name, what was edited). Recordings: CC0, public domain or CC-BY only (never NC, ND,
Sampling+ or unknown licences); one row per recording below.

| Files | What | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assets/audio/standin/*` | Synthesised stand-ins for every sound still without an acceptable recording: engine loops at four rpm points on and off load per vehicle kind (16-bit WAV), engine start/stop, horns, doors, gear change, crashes, tyre squeal, wind, sirens, footsteps (dry and wet), landing, city hum, rain, sea, crickets, crows, koel, interface cues (OGG Vorbis) | Original, synthesised by `tools/audio/render_standins.gd` from the designs in `src/audio/sound_profiles.gd` and `src/audio/synth.gd` (the Three.js game's TD-26 sound design) | **CC0 1.0**, original work for the project |
